page.title: Crystal Database
page.subtitle: Manage CIF crystal structure files. Parse, inspect, and convert to EMsoft .xtal format.

toolbar.buildTooltip: Parse all CIF files into the crystal database (crystal_database.xlsx); shows live progress.
toolbar.viewDatabaseTooltip: Open the built crystal database in a searchable, sortable spreadsheet viewer.
toolbar.viewDwfTooltip: Edit per-element Debye-Waller factors used during CIF to XTAL conversion.
toolbar.syncTooltip: Synchronize CIF/XTAL files with the network server; resolves conflicts.

sync.title: Crystal Sync Results
sync.conflictsHint: — choose an action for each file

hoverTips.editFieldInput: Type the new value; press Enter to save or Escape to cancel.
hoverTips.editFieldSave: Save the edited DOI or reference for this CIF.
hoverTips.editFieldCancel: Discard the edit and keep the previous value.
hoverTips.dbSearch: Filter the database rows by text across all columns.
hoverTips.dbClose: Close the database viewer without applying further changes.
hoverTips.dbEditCell: Edit this cell; press Enter to commit or Escape to cancel.
hoverTips.dbSortColumn: Click to sort by this column; click again to reverse the order.
hoverTips.deleteStart: Delete the checked CIF (and any matching .xtal) files — asks for confirmation.
hoverTips.deleteCancel: Cancel the delete; no files are removed.
hoverTips.dwfSearch: Filter the DWF table by element symbol or reference.
hoverTips.dwfClose: Close the DWF table without applying further changes.
hoverTips.dwfElementCell: Edit the element symbol for this new DWF row.
hoverTips.dwfNewElement: Element symbol for the new DWF entry (e.g. Cu).
hoverTips.dwfNewValue: Debye-Waller B value at 300 K in nm² for the new element.
hoverTips.dwfNewReference: Literature source for the new element's DWF value.
hoverTips.syncResolveKeepLocal: Keep your local copy and upload it to the server.
hoverTips.syncResolveKeepServer: Use the server copy and overwrite local — local edits are lost.
hoverTips.syncResolveKeepBoth: Keep both; the server copy is downloaded under a renamed file.
hoverTips.syncResolveSkip: Leave this file untouched on both sides for now.
hoverTips.syncErrorsToggle: Show or hide the list of sync errors.
hoverTips.syncClose: Close the sync results without resolving conflicts.
hoverTips.syncBulkKeepLocal: Set every conflict to Keep Local (upload local to server).
hoverTips.syncBulkKeepServer: Set every conflict to Keep Server (overwrites all local edits).
hoverTips.syncBulkKeepBoth: Set every conflict to Keep Both (server copies renamed).
hoverTips.syncBulkSkip: Set every conflict to Skip (no file changed).
hoverTips.syncResolveAll: Apply the chosen action to every conflict and finish syncing.

fitWarnings.no_reference: No DOI or reference found. Converting to .xtal will ask you to add one or to declare the data unpublished.
fitWarnings.p1_hidden_symmetry: Stored as space group P 1, but the atom positions have the symmetry {{symbol}} (#{{number}}) at every tolerance from 0.01 to 0.1 Å. Hough indexing of a P 1 file can run out of memory; save a symmetrised copy.
fitWarnings.p1_ambiguous_symmetry: Stored as space group P 1; the symmetry of the atom positions depends on the tolerance ({{ladder}}). Choose a tolerance to save a symmetrised copy.
fitWarnings.contradictory_header: The header contradicts itself: it gives space group number {{headerNumber}}, but the space group symbol {{headerSymbol}}. No symmetrised copy is offered; correct the header first.
fitWarnings.p1_check_failed: Stored as space group P 1; the check for hidden symmetry could not be completed ({{detail}}), so no symmetrised copy is offered.

referenceDialog.title: No reference for this crystal structure
referenceDialog.messageOne: {{name}} has no DOI or literature reference. The .xtal file records where its crystal data come from, so enter one here or say that the data are unpublished.
referenceDialog.messageMany: {{count}} selected CIF files have no DOI or literature reference. The .xtal files record where their crystal data come from.
referenceDialog.inputPlaceholder: 10.1234/example or Author et al., Journal, Year
referenceDialog.inputHint: A DOI (10.…) is saved as the DOI, any other text as the reference.
referenceDialog.willSaveDoi: Will be saved into the CIF as its DOI.
referenceDialog.willSaveCitation: Will be saved into the CIF as its reference text.
referenceDialog.unpublishedNote: “Unpublished / own data” writes “unpublished (declared by user)” as the reference and marks it as your declaration. It is never left as “unknown”.
referenceDialog.declareTooltip: Convert with the reference “unpublished (declared by user)”
referenceDialog.skipTooltip: Convert only the files that have a reference

symmetriseReasons.not_p1: The file is not stored as space group P 1.
symmetriseReasons.disordered: The structure has partially occupied sites; a symmetry found from its positions would be a guess about the sample.
symmetriseReasons.no_symmetry: No symmetry above P 1 was found at any tolerance from 0.01 to 0.1 Å.
symmetriseReasons.changed_structure: The symmetrised structure no longer matches the file within tolerance, so nothing was written.
symmetriseReasons.unreadable: The file could not be read as a crystal structure.
symmetriseReasons.not_writable: The folder of this CIF file is not writable, so no copy was saved.
symmetriseReasons.same_content_exists: The same crystal is already in this folder as {{existing}}; no second copy was written.
symmetriseReasons.ambiguous_tolerance: The group of the atom positions depends on the tolerance; choose one.
symmetriseReasons.invalid_tolerance: The tolerance must be one of 0.01, 0.02, 0.05 or 0.1 Å.
symmetriseReasons.contradictory_header: The header contradicts itself (the space group number and the symbol disagree about P 1), so no copy was written. Correct the header first.
